During the squeezing stage, the necking rate and breakup time are governed by the pinning of the dispersed-phase contact line on the channel wall. Compared with constant electric forcing, pulsed electric forcing introduces an additional temporal degree of freedom, enabling stage-dependent modulation of interfacial evolution and breakup dynamics. Finally, droplet sequence diagrams and regime maps are presented for different pulse parameters. The results demonstrate that pulsed electrohydrodynamics in a T-junction enables active and programmable control of consecutive droplet generation.

AI.tldr: 采用相场-格子Boltzmann方法数值模拟脉冲电水动力下T型微通道内的液滴生成，比较无电场、上偏置电极和下偏置电极三种配置，并按填充阶段与挤压阶段分析电场对界面演化、颈缩和断裂的影响；结果表明脉冲电场可阶段依赖地调控液滴生成，实现主动且可编程的控制。摘要未给出具体定量参数。
AI.motivation: 研究脉冲电水动力下T型微通道内液滴生成动力学，明确电场空间分布和脉冲参数如何改变界面形貌、流体动力应力分布及液滴生成阶段，从而实现对连续液滴生成的主动、可编程调控。
AI.method: 基于相场-格子Boltzmann方法开展数值模拟；考察无电场、上偏置电极和下偏置电极三种配置；通过理论分析将液滴生成过程划分为填充阶段和挤压阶段；比较恒定电场与脉冲电场的作用，并给出不同脉冲参数下的液滴序列图和流型区域图。
AI.result: 上偏置电极促使分散相快速向通道上壁横向迁移，加速进入堵塞阶段；下偏置电极下分散相先黏附下壁，再在电场力作用下向上变形；电场空间分布强烈影响液滴生成动力学。填充阶段电场力改变填充时长，但对填充流量影响很小；挤压阶段颈缩速率和断裂时间受分散相接触线在通道壁面钉扎的控制。相比恒定电场，脉冲电场引入额外时间自由度，实现阶段依赖的界面演化和断裂调控。摘要未提供具体数值结果和实验验证细节。
AI.conclusion: 在T型微通道中，脉冲电水动力能够对连续液滴生成实现主动且可编程的控制；不同脉冲参数下的液滴序列图和流型区域图可用于表征其调控规律。

title: A boundary integral equation solver for capsule suspensions
summary: Deformable capsules serve as models for biological cells, such as red blood cells, as well as for synthetic capsules in biomedical and industrial applications. In this work, we introduce a framework for fast and robust simulation of deformable capsules in three-dimensional Stokes flow, both in unbounded domains and in pipe-confined geometries. We solve the Stokes equations using a boundary integral formulation, employing a partition-of-unity discretization for the capsule membrane and the trapezoidal rule with regularization to handle the singular quadrature. Dense periodic interactions are evaluated via a fast Ewald summation scheme, achieving $O(N \log N)$ complexity for $N$ grid points. The interfacial forces on the capsule membrane are modeled using the Skalak constitutive law. We carry out a spectral analysis of this model for small perturbations of a spherical capsule, which indicates that the relaxation dynamics are intrinsically stable. However, the nonlinear character of the Skalak model induces aliasing errors that can compromise numerical stability. To address this when needed, we perform de-aliasing through upsampling and spectral filtering, and we derive guidelines for choosing appropriate filter parameters, thereby stabilizing the method. We investigate the stability and convergence behavior of the resulting scheme and conduct simulations of long-time dynamics, focusing on the relaxation of unconfined capsules and the lateral migration of pipe-confined capsules under various flow conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个用于三维Stokes流中可变形胶囊快速稳健模拟的数值框架，适用于无界域和管道约束几何；采用边界积分、单位分解膜离散、正则化梯形求积和快速Ewald求和，结合Skalak本构、谱稳定性分析及去混叠滤波，并开展长期动力学模拟。
AI.motivation: 可变形胶囊可作为红细胞等生物细胞以及生物医学和工业应用中合成胶囊的模型，因此需要在无界域和管道约束条件下对三维Stokes流中的胶囊进行快速且稳健的仿真。
AI.method: 采用边界积分形式求解Stokes方程；对胶囊膜使用单位分解离散，并用带正则化的梯形法则处理奇异求积；周期密集相互作用通过快速Ewald求和计算，达到O(N log N)复杂度；界面力采用Skalak本构模型；对球形胶囊小扰动进行谱分析；针对Skalak非线性引起的混叠误差，采用上采样和谱滤波去混叠，并给出滤波器参数选择准则；开展稳定性与收敛性研究及长期动力学模拟。
AI.result: 谱分析表明球形胶囊小扰动的弛豫动力学本质稳定，但Skalak模型的非线性会产生混叠误差并可能损害数值稳定性；按需进行上采样和谱滤波去混叠可稳定方法，并给出了滤波器参数选择指南；论文研究了所得格式的稳定性和收敛行为，并模拟了无约束胶囊弛豫及管道约束胶囊在不同流动条件下的横向迁移。摘要未提供定量结果或具体参数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了面向无界域和管道约束三维Stokes流的快速稳健可变形胶囊模拟框架，说明谱分析下弛豫本质稳定，但非线性Skalak模型可能导致混叠并需去混叠处理；通过上采样、谱滤波及参数选择准则可增强数值稳定性，并支持长期动力学研究。摘要未给出与其他方法的定量比较或明确应用结论。

title: Lacrymaria-like dynamics: compression and length change in active slender bodies
summary: Length change is central to the behaviour of many active slender bodies, yet most elastohydrodynamic models of microscopic locomotion treat filaments as effectively inextensible. Here we introduce a compressible $N$-link formulation for planar active filaments, in which both bending angles and segment lengths are dynamical variables coupled through local hydrodynamic drag, modelled using resistive force theory. We first use the model to test whether passive extensibility can improve bending-driven swimming and crawling. Across the parameter ranges studied, passive compressibility usually reduces locomotion speed, indicating that axial compliance alone is not a robust mechanism for propulsion enhancement. We then prescribe active rest-length waves and show that compression can either enhance, suppress, or redirect locomotion depending on its phase, wavelength, and frequency relative to bending. Finally, motivated by the extensible neck dynamics of \textit{Lacrymaria olor}, we apply the method to clamped and free filaments driven by oscillatory follower forces. These examples show that elastic compression-bending coupling can reorganise swimming, exploration, and locomotion in strongly deforming active filaments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可压缩N连杆平面活性细丝模型，将弯曲角与段长作为动力学变量并通过局部水动力阻力耦合。研究表明被动轴向柔性通常降低运动速度，而主动静止长度波可依相位、波长和频率增强、抑制或改变运动方向；模型还应用于受振荡跟随力驱动的钳制与自由细丝。
AI.motivation: 长度变化对许多活性细长体的行为至关重要，但多数微观运动弹性水动力模型将细丝视为不可伸长。作者希望检验被动可伸长性是否能改善弯曲驱动的游动与爬行，并研究主动长度变化对推进的影响；Lacrymaria olor可伸展颈部的动力学也构成应用动机。
AI.method: 建立可压缩N连杆平面活性细丝模型，使弯曲角和各段长度均为动力学变量，并通过局部水动力阻力耦合，阻力采用阻力理论建模。先用该模型测试被动可伸长性对弯曲驱动游动和爬行的影响，再设定主动静止长度波，考察压缩相对于弯曲的相位、波长和频率的作用；最后将方法用于受振荡跟随力驱动的钳制和自由细丝。
AI.result: 在所研究的参数范围内，被动可压缩性通常会降低运动速度，说明仅靠轴向柔性并不是稳健的推进增强机制。预设主动静止长度波时，压缩可依其相对于弯曲的相位、波长和频率增强、抑制或改变运动方向。钳制与自由细丝示例表明，弹性压缩—弯曲耦合能够重组强变形活性细丝的游动、探索和运动行为；摘要未给出定量数值。
AI.conclusion: 轴向柔性本身不足以稳健提升推进，但主动长度变化与弯曲的耦合可调控甚至重新组织强变形活性细丝的游动、探索和运动；可压缩N连杆框架为研究长度变化在微观活性细丝运动中的作用提供了方法。摘要未提供具体定量结论或实验验证细节。

title: A 3D PINN-Based Framework for Patient-Specific Pulmonary Hemodynamics Using Windkessel Models
summary:
Cardiovascular fluid dynamics modeling relies heavily on mesh-based numerical methods such as Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD). While accurate, these methods entail significant computational costs and complex meshing workflows that limit their translation to clinical practice. Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) are a promising meshless alternative that embeds the governing equations directly into neural network training. In this work, we propose a PINN framework for pulsatile blood flow in patient-specific geometries with dynamic lumped-parameter Windkessel (RCR) outlet conditions representing distal vascular impedance.
  Coupling the Windkessel ODE to a 3D network raises two difficulties: the ODE alone does not fix the pressure level, and the local pressure variations that drive the flow are orders of magnitude smaller than the basal pressure imposed by the outlet. We address them by decomposing pressure into a time-dependent basal part and a spatially varying part, an initial condition and gauge for the Windkessel equation, a global mass-balance constraint, and a periodic Fourier embedding of time. Validated on 2D canonical channels (steady and pulsatile, with and without RCR outlet), the framework is then applied to a patient-specific right pulmonary artery, reproducing outlet flow, mean pressure, and the velocity and dynamic pressure fields with errors on the order of the data resolution.
  Finally, we solve the inverse problem of identifying the three Windkessel parameters of the outlet from synthetic data, recovering them with errors of about 0.3% from deliberately wrong initial values. Residual biases in the local pressure field and the need to test robustness to noisy clinical data remain open, but the results support PINNs as complementary tools for meshless hemodynamics and patient-specific digital twins.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种用于患者个体化几何中搏动血流的物理信息神经网络框架，耦合动态RCR Windkessel出口条件，并在二维算例和右肺动脉上验证正问题与参数反演。
AI.motivation: 基于网格的CFD虽准确，但计算成本高、网格流程复杂，限制其临床转化；PINNs作为无网格替代方案，可将控制方程嵌入训练，因此值得探索其在个体化血流建模中的应用。
AI.method: 构建PINN框架模拟搏动血流，并在患者个体化几何中耦合代表远端血管阻抗的动态集中参数Windkessel（RCR）出口条件。针对Windkessel ODE与三维网络耦合的困难，采用压力分解为时间相关基础压力与空间变化压力、为Windkessel方程设置初始条件和规范、全局质量平衡约束以及时间的周期Fourier嵌入。先在二维规则通道（稳态与搏动、含与不含RCR出口）验证，再应用于患者右肺动脉，并利用合成数据反演出口的三个Windkessel参数。
AI.result: 在二维算例验证后，框架应用于患者右肺动脉，可复现出口流量、平均压力以及速度场和动态压力场，误差量级接近数据分辨率；反演问题从故意错误的初值出发，三个Windkessel参数恢复误差约0.3%。局部压力场仍存在残差偏差，且对含噪临床数据的稳健性尚待测试。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明PINNs可作为无网格血流动力学和患者个体化数字孪生的补充工具；但局部压力残差偏差及噪声临床数据稳健性仍是开放问题。

title: Ultrasensitive measurement of phase dynamics by time-holographic dark-port readout of a marginally imbalanced interferometer
summary: Resolving displacements and surface irregularities far below a nanometer is now indispensable across fields, from precision manufacturing and biotechnology to nanoscience and fundamental metrology. High-precision optical interferometry reaches this $λ/1{,}000$ regime by reading out optical power, which provides a smooth response over the measurement range. Here we instead read out the complex dark-port field of a marginally imbalanced interferometer, whose phase response to small internal phase deviations $φ_{\textrm{in}}$ near destructive interference becomes extremely steep. For a small arm-amplitude imbalance $μ$, the tangent $T_{\textrm{out}}$ of the dark-port phase reduces to $μ^{-1}φ_{\textrm{in}}$, defining a phase magnification $M=μ^{-1}$. Crucially, this tangent estimator stays linear over a range $|φ_{\textrm{in}}|\lesssim\sqrt{|μ|}$---much larger than the imbalance $|μ|$ itself for $|μ|\ll1$---so that fine temporal substructure is resolved within much larger phase excursions. $T_{\textrm{out}}$ is synthesized from the dark-port complex field by optical time-domain holography and Fourier demodulation---a heterodyne readout that is intrinsically immune to laser relative-intensity noise at any magnification, and gives time-resolved access to phase dynamics. In a proof-of-principle Mach--Zehnder experiment, without optimization or environmental isolation, we demonstrate $|M|>10^3$ and optical-path resolution better than $λ/100{,}000$ ($\approx5~\textrm{pm}$), with a shot-noise floor orders of magnitude below this environment-limited value. The approach is compact, tunable, and compatible with existing interferometric platforms, offering a practical route to enhanced phase sensitivity in metrology, sensing, and optical instrumentation.

AI.tldr: 通过近暗态干涉的暗端口复场相位读出，将微小臂振幅失配转化为相位放大，实现不受激光相对强度噪声影响的时间分辨光程测量；原理验证获得超过10^3的放大和优于λ/100,000（约5 pm）的光程分辨。
AI.motivation: 亚纳米乃至更小位移和表面不规则测量在精密制造、生物技术、纳米科学和基础计量中不可或缺；现有高精度光学干涉通过光功率读出可达λ/1,000量级，本文希望利用近相消干涉处暗端口相位的陡峭响应获得更高相位灵敏度。
AI.method: 读取轻微失衡干涉仪的暗端口复场；对小臂振幅失配μ，暗端口相位正切T_out约化为μ^{-1}φ_in，定义相位放大M=μ^{-1}。该正切估计器在|φ_in|≲sqrt(|μ|)范围内保持线性，对小μ远大于|μ|本身。通过光学时域全息和傅里叶解调合成T_out，属于外差读出，原则上对任意放大倍率免疫激光相对强度噪声，并可时间分辨地访问相位动力学；采用马赫-曾德尔干涉仪进行原理验证。
AI.result: 在未优化、无环境隔离的原理验证实验中，实现|M|>10^3，光程分辨优于λ/100,000（约5 pm）；散粒噪声基底比环境受限值低数个量级。摘要未给出具体工作波长、测量带宽、长期稳定性及完整噪声预算。
AI.conclusion: 该方法紧凑、可调且兼容现有干涉平台，为计量、传感和光学仪器提供增强相位灵敏度的实用路径，并能在较大相位偏移内分辨精细时间结构；摘要未提供实际计量或传感场景的应用验证数据。

title: Forbidden T-symmetry breaking in time-dependent non-Hermitian systems with gain and loss
summary: Parity-time ($PT$) symmetry has attracted significant interest in photonics and related fields in recent years. With sufficiently weak gain and loss, these systems typically exhibit entirely real energy levels, with all corresponding wave functions remaining $PT$ symmetric. As the strength of gain and loss increases, complex-conjugate energy levels are expected to emerge, signaling the onset of $PT$ symmetry breaking. Similar properties can be found in non-Hermitian systems with other antilinear symmetries as well, where parity is replaced by another operator such as rotation ($R$) or simply the identity operator, resulting in $RT$-symmetric and $T$-symmetric non-Hermitian systems. In this work, we demonstrate that this typical scenario of non-Hermitian symmetry breaking in a finite Hilbert space is forbidden in a class of time-dependent systems with gain and loss and $T$ symmetry: the system remains in its $T$-symmetric phase as we increase the strength of gain and loss, even when the spatial distribution of gain and loss is random. Furthermore, this behavior is also independent of the duration or period of the temporal modulation. In contrast, this forbidden non-Hermitian symmetry breaking does not occur when the same systems are modified to display $PT$ symmetry instead. Our findings highlight contrasting behaviors in time-dependent and time-independent non-Hermitian systems, creating new possibilities and opportunities for future investigations.

AI.tldr: 在一类具有T对称性的含增益和损耗的时变非厄米系统中，有限希尔伯特空间内通常的非厄米对称性破缺被禁止：即使增强增益/损耗、采用随机空间分布或改变时间调制时长/周期，系统仍保持T对称相；而将同一系统改为PT对称时，该禁止现象不再出现。
AI.motivation: PT对称及其破缺在光子学及相关领域受到广泛关注，通常增益和损耗增强会导致复共轭能级出现并标志对称性破缺；作者希望检验这类典型非厄米对称性破缺在时变、含增益和损耗且具有T对称性的有限希尔伯特空间系统中是否仍然成立。
AI.method: 论文以理论论证/演示的方式研究一类时间依赖、含增益和损耗且具有T对称性的非厄米系统，并考察增益和损耗强度增加、其空间分布随机化以及时间调制时长或周期变化时的对称性相；同时将这些系统修改为具有PT对称性进行对比。摘要未给出具体模型、数学技巧或实验平台。
AI.result: 研究发现，在这类时变T对称系统中，通常的非厄米对称性破缺被禁止：随着增益和损耗增强，系统仍处于T对称相，即使增益和损耗的空间分布是随机的；该行为也不依赖于时间调制的时长或周期。相反，当相同系统改为PT对称时，这种被禁止的对称性破缺不会发生。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了时变与时不变非厄米系统在对称性破缺行为上的鲜明对比，为后续研究提供了新的可能性和机会。

title: Adaptive-Optics-Aware Uplink and Downlink Analysis of Ground-to-HAPS FSO Links
summary: In this paper, we present an adaptive optics (AO)-aware analytical framework for ground-to- high-altitude platform station (HAPS) free-space optical (FSO) links considering both uplink (UL) and downlink (DL) transmission. The proposed model combines atmospheric attenuation, Exponentiated Weibull (EW) turbulence, Beckmann-type pointing error (PE), and field-of-view (FoV)-limited angle-of-arrival (AOA) loss. Adaptive optics correction (AOC) is incorporated through the number of corrected modes, allowing the impact of partial and stronger wavefront compensation to be directly reflected in the channel statistics. Analytical and numerically tractable expressions are derived for the outage probability (OP), average bit-error rate (BER), and an ergodic achievable-rate lower bound (EALB) optical channel. High signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) approximations are also developed, showing that AOA/FoV blocking introduces irreducible OP and BER floors, while the decaying nonblocked component is governed by the small-channel-gain behavior of the turbulence and PE distributions. Numerical results demonstrate that the DL generally outperforms the UL because of the direction-dependent interaction with near-ground turbulence. The results also show that increasing the number of AOC modes improves OP, BER, and the EALB, although the improvement gradually saturates. The effects of average SNR, HAPS altitude, zenith angle, beam waist, boresight error, and receiver FoV are further investigated to provide practical design insight for AO-assisted ground-to-HAPS FSO systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种考虑自适应光学的星地—高空平台站自由空间光链路分析框架，覆盖上行和下行，联合建模大气衰减、指数化威布尔湍流、Beckmann型指向误差及视场受限到达角损耗，并推导中断概率、平均误码率和遍历可达速率下界的解析表达式及高信噪比近似。

title: Emergent Fourfold Symmetry in Polarization Images: Local Origin and Diffractive Breakdown
comment: Preprint. 8 pages, 3 figures. Supplementary material: 45 pages, 19 figures
summary: A polarization image can gain or lose rotational symmetry with no change in material symmetry. In axisymmetric anisotropic systems, covariance restricts the field to azimuthal orders $m=0,\pm2$, guaranteeing twofold but not fourfold symmetry; pointwise unitarity adds fourfold symmetry, which diffraction can destroy. Holographic Jones fields of liquid-crystal torons show propagation shifts the twofold--fourfold balance; for the same director, a marching-wave model qualitatively reproduces the twofold morphology missed by a local model. This establishes a symmetry hierarchy for polarization imaging.

AI.tldr: 偏振图像的旋转对称性可以在材料对称性不变时增强或减弱；在轴对称各向异性体系中，协变性把场限制到方位角阶数 m=0,±2，因而保证二重对称但不保证四重对称；点式幺正性会补充四重对称，而衍射可能破坏四重对称。液晶 toron 的全息 Jones 场表明，传播会改变二重与四重对称之间的平衡；对同一指向矢，行波模型定性地重现了局域模型遗漏的二重形貌，由此建立偏振成像的对称性层级。
AI.motivation: 阐明偏振图像的旋转对称性与材料对称性并非简单对应，并解释轴对称各向异性体系中二重、四重对称的来源以及传播和衍射的影响，为偏振成像建立对称性层级。
AI.method: 基于轴对称各向异性体系的协变性和方位角阶数限制（m=0,±2），结合点式幺正性分析四重对称；使用液晶 toron 的全息 Jones 场考察传播效应，并将行波模型与局域模型进行对照。摘要未提供具体实验条件和定量指标。
AI.result: 协变性保证二重对称但不保证四重对称；点式幺正性可赋予四重对称，衍射可将其破坏。全息 Jones 场显示传播会移动二重与四重对称之间的平衡；对同一指向矢，行波模型定性地重现了局域模型遗漏的二重形貌。
AI.conclusion: 偏振成像中的旋转对称性应理解为由协变性、幺正性以及传播和衍射共同约束的层级结构，不能仅由材料对称性直接推断；行波传播建模对于解释偏振图像形貌是必要的。

title: Single-shot holographic gradients for training wavefronts through disorder
summary: Training optical systems in situ needs the gradient of their loss, yet a camera records only intensity and the medium is never exactly known. We show that one off-axis hologram gives this gradient, an approach we call holographic gradients. Light passes through the medium only forward; the hologram measures the error, and a compact adjoint, fitted to ten probes, is refreshed in seconds during train- ing. Each step costs one modulated pattern. Through a thin diffuser, it focuses light and forms images as well as a measured transmission matrix, without its thousands of patterns. Under controlled drift, refreshing the adjoint recovers a grating to 17.6 dB, against 9.1 dB for a frozen model and 19.5 dB without drift, and training succeeds through a thick diffuser. Trained offline, the reference beam becomes a computing layer that plays a video game. Holographic gradients let optical systems learn while they operate, from imaging through dynamic media to self-correcting processors.

AI.tldr: 提出“全息梯度”方法：用单张离轴全息图直接获取光学系统损失梯度，使系统在原位训练中仅需前向传播和少量调制图案，并在扩散器成像、漂移补偿及光学计算任务中验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 原位训练光学系统需要损失梯度，但相机只记录强度，且介质特性从未精确已知，传统方法还需大量测量图案，难以支持动态介质中的在线学习。
AI.method: 让光仅前向通过介质，由离轴全息图测量误差；用一个仅基于十个探针拟合的紧凑伴随模型给出梯度，并在训练中数秒内刷新，每步只需一个调制图案。摘要未提供具体光学架构、损失函数及训练超参数的细节。

AI.conclusion: 全息梯度使光学系统能够在运行中学习，应用涵盖动态介质成像与自校正处理器；摘要未给出长期稳定性、可扩展性及实际部署限制的定量结论。

title: Monolithic ultraviolet-to- near infrared photodetection enabled by an aluminium oxide photonic platform
summary: Broadband photonic integrated circuits require waveguide platforms that combine low optical loss across a wide spectral range with integrated photodetection. Here we demonstrate a monolithically integrated atomic-layer-deposited (ALD) aluminium oxide (Al$_2$O$_3$)-on-silicon platform enabling waveguide-coupled photodetection from the ultraviolet to the near-infrared. The architecture employs evanescent coupling between low-loss Al$_2$O$_3$ waveguides and silicon p-i-n photodiodes. The platform supports photodetection at 375, 658 and 780 nm, extending integrated silicon photodetection into the ultraviolet. The devices exhibit linear photocurrent scaling with optical power, dark currents of approximately 2 pA at 50 V reverse bias and nanosecond-scale temporal response. We further demonstrate centimetre-scale ultraviolet Mach-Zehnder interferometer circuits with integrated photodiodes. The same detector architecture is implemented with Si$_3$N$_4$ waveguides, whereas the lower ultraviolet propagation loss of Al$_2$O$_3$ enables an approximately 15-fold higher photodetection response at 375 nm. These results establish ALD Al$_2$O$_3$ as a broadband integrated photonics platform for sensing, spectroscopy and quantum technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一种单片集成的 ALD Al₂O₃-on-silicon 光子平台，通过 Al₂O₃ 波导与硅 p-i-n 光电二极管之间的倏逝耦合，实现从紫外到近红外的波导耦合光电探测，并在 375、658 和 780 nm 处验证探测；同时展示了厘米级紫外马赫-曾德尔干涉仪电路及与 Si₃N₄ 平台的对比。

AI.method: 采用原子层沉积（ALD）制备单片集成的 Al₂O₃-on-silicon 平台，利用低损耗 Al₂O₃ 波导与硅 p-i-n 光电二极管之间的倏逝耦合实现波导耦合探测；并以 Si₃N₄ 波导实现相同探测器架构进行对比。

title: Composite Dielectric-Loaded Metallic Metagratings for Dual-Polarized Transmissive Beam Manipulation
summary: We present and experimentally demonstrate a comprehensive analytical suite for the design of transmissive metal-based metagratings (MGs) for dual-polarized anomalous refraction. Considering a composite configuration of perforated metallic slabs with controlled dielectric loading, we develop a rigorous mode-matching formulation tying the various MG degrees of freedom to the various reflected and transmitted Floquet-Bloch modes, enabling efficient beam deflection for both transverse electric (TE) and transverse magnetic (TM) polarizations. Inherently versatile, the analytical framework accurately models single-layer and double-layer constructs with multiple rectangular perforations per unit cell, each potentially loaded with dielectric material. We harness this degree-of-freedom abundance to devise diverse polarization-sensitive transmissive MGs, ranging from all-metallic single-layer and double-layer structures for single-polarized (TM or TE) perfect anomalous refraction, to dielectric-loaded architectures implementing dual-polarized routing of the incident wave. Beyond highlighting concrete paths to address TE-polarized fields in such formations, our results, validated via full-wave simulations and experiments at K band, showcase the great potential of metal-based MGs for manipulating fields in transmission, facilitating effective synthesis of durable dual-polarized beamforming superstrates for environmentally demanding and high power antenna applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实验验证了一套面向金属基透射型超光栅的综合解析设计方法，可建模单/双层、多矩形穿孔及介质加载结构，实现TE/TM双极化异常折射，并在K波段通过全波仿真与实验验证。

AI.conclusion: 金属基超光栅在透射场调控方面具有较大潜力，可用于合成耐用、双极化波束赋形超strates，适用于环境严苛和高功率天线应用。

title: Efficient convolution-based nonparaxial propagation of partially coherent light
comment: 38 pages, 14 figures, and 4 tables in total, including a 19-page supplement with 6 figures and 2 tables
summary: We derive an efficient formulation for wide-angle propagation of partially coherent light from extended incoherent sources, extending the generalized van Cittert-Zernike Schell (GVS) propagator beyond the paraxial regime with absolute radiometric normalization. Within the Fresnel model, we establish that GVS and the classical paraxial source-PSF convolution are algebraically equivalent, explicitly deriving the corresponding source inversion, magnification, and absolute radiometric normalization. The resulting separation of mapped source and coherent pupil response enables wide-angle convolution in direction-cosine coordinates. Within a physically motivated diffracted-radiance formulation, this far-field convolution is exact for incoherent plane-wave mixtures. The same power prescription also relates delta-correlated source statistics to Lambertian radiance and hemispherical emitted power. At finite distances, we use a common incident curvature and approximate the source contributions by shifting and weighting a single coherent monitor response in direction-cosine coordinates. The differentiable formulation supports gradient-based inverse design of diffractive elements and metasurfaces represented by scalar pupils. Examples reveal geometric distortion and irradiance fall-off missed by the paraxial models and demonstrate wide-angle beam shaping at finite distances. A benchmark shows orders of magnitude faster evaluation than source-by-source propagation with a common error tolerance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种具有绝对辐射度归一化、超越傍轴近似的高效宽角部分相干光传播公式，将广义van Cittert-Zernike Schell（GVS）传播器扩展至宽角情形，并用于有限距离宽角光束整形与可微逆设计。
AI.motivation: 针对扩展非相干源产生的部分相干光，需要一种高效且具备绝对辐射度归一化的宽角传播描述，以克服传统傍轴模型在几何畸变和辐照度衰减等方面的限制，并支持衍射元件与超表面的梯度逆设计。
AI.method: 在Fresnel模型下证明GVS与经典傍轴源-PSF卷积代数等价，并推导源反演、放大率和绝对辐射度归一化；利用映射源与相干光瞳响应的分离，在方向余弦坐标中实现宽角卷积。在衍射辐射度表述下，该远场卷积对非相干平面波混合是精确的；同一功率约定将delta相关源统计与Lambertian辐射度和半球发射功率联系起来。有限距离下采用共同入射曲率，通过在方向余弦坐标中平移和加权单个相干监测响应来近似源贡献。该可微公式支持以标量光瞳表示的衍射元件和超表面的梯度逆设计。
AI.result: 示例揭示了傍轴模型遗漏的几何畸变和辐照度衰减，并展示了有限距离下的宽角光束整形；基准测试表明，在共同误差容限下，其评估速度比逐源传播快数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了高效、宽角、部分相干且具绝对辐射度归一化的传播与设计框架：远场在所述衍射辐射度表述下对非相干平面波混合精确，有限距离采用近似处理；摘要未提供具体误差量、实验验证或更广泛的适用性限制。

title: Probabilistic image generation conditioned on an optical latent code
summary: While diffractive optical networks compress images into compact representations, such measurements have predominantly served discriminative inference or deterministic reconstruction. Here we demonstrate probabilistic image generation conditioned solely on a 16_bit binary optical latent code (OLC) formed by a diffractive encoder and binarized camera readout. The intentionally many-to-one mapping makes each OLC specify a class of OLC-compatible images rather than a unique reconstruction target. An OLC_conditioned conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) learns this distribution, while optical re-encoding promotes consistency between generated images and the measured OLC. Numerical characterization and proof-of-concept acquisition with a spatial light modulator_camera system establish the OLC as a physically accessible generative condition. On MNIST, samples generated from a single OLC vary in morphology while preserving class identity, and their optical-recognition accuracy reaches 81.6%, close to the 81.9% obtained from the source OLCs. These results link compact optical sensing to probabilistic synthesis of optically recognizable images.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用衍射编码器与二值化相机读出形成的16位二值光学潜码，条件化CVAE实现概率图像生成；在MNIST上生成样本保持类别身份，光学识别准确率81.6%，接近源OLC的81.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有衍射光学网络虽能将图像压缩为紧凑表示，但测量主要用于判别推理或确定性重建；作者希望仅凭紧凑的光学潜码实现概率生成，并利用有意多对一映射让一个OLC对应一类兼容图像，而非唯一重建目标。
AI.method: 构建由衍射编码器和二值化相机读出组成的16位二值OLC；用OLC条件化CVAE学习OLC兼容图像分布，并通过光学重编码提升生成图像与实测OLC的一致性；开展数值表征及SLM-相机系统的概念验证采集。
AI.result: 在MNIST上，单一OLC生成的样本形态变化但保持类别身份；其光学识别准确率达到81.6%，与源OLC的81.9%接近。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明紧凑光学传感可用于概率合成光学可识别图像，将压缩光学测量从判别或确定性重建拓展到条件概率生成。

title: Dissipative erasure of pulse-to-pulse dispersion imbalance in ultrafast burst-mode lasers
summary: Ultrafast GHz bursts enable laser-matter interactions where successive excitations collectively build sustained nonequilibrium states and efficient material interactions. However, directly generating pulse trains at GHz rates remains challenging. Alternatively, repetition-rate multipliers (RRMs) divide each oscillator pulse into equidistant replicas, but either suffer from dispersion imbalances that prevent simultaneous compression or are limited to few pulses per burst. Here, we introduce dissipative erasure, which first suppresses the differences by spectral filtering and then regenerates the optical bandwidth via nonlinear amplification without restoring the erased differences. We derive two scaling results: as the repetition rate increases geometrically with RRM stages, maximum path differences approach a finite limit; meanwhile, dispersive differences weaken quadratically with filtering. We demonstrate dissipative erasure experimentally, generating 100-$μ$J bursts, comprising thousands of 100-fs pulses at 51.3 GHz, from a Yb-fiber amplifier. Dissipative erasure has diverse potential applications for suppressing deterministic or stochastic differences before recovering desired optical properties.

title: Feshbach Projection Formalism for Resonant Electrodynamics
summary: Open resonant photonic systems are widely described by effective non-Hermitian formalisms, such as temporal coupled-mode theory, which capture radiative decay through complex eigenfrequencies. In conventional formulations, however, these effective models remain largely phenomenological, lacking a direct microscopic connection to the underlying Maxwell equations. To bridge this gap, we present an analytically tractable light-matter framework based on the Feshbach projection formalism applied to classical electrodynamics. Starting from a coupled system of mechanical oscillator and a one-dimensional electromagnetic field, we construct a strictly Hermitian first-order Hamiltonian. We demonstrate that rigorously eliminating the electromagnetic degrees of freedom via the outgoing Green's function automatically generates a non-Hermitian mechanical operator. Crucially, the resulting radiative damping is determined by the local electromagnetic response rather than introduced ad hoc. Furthermore, we extend this framework to two spatially separated dipoles and show how field retardation transforms a finite set of discrete modes into a countably infinite Fabry-Perot-like spectrum as the separation deviates from zero. The proposed framework provides an intuitive yet rigorous foundation for deriving effective non-Hermitian dynamics directly from conservative light-matter interactions.

An analytical treatment of the steady-state equations shows that the auxiliary cavity renormalizes the effective optical linewidth and detuning, while the collective molecular interaction generates an effective nonlinearity. Together, these effects enable control of the hysteretic regime through optical detuning, cavity-plasmon coupling, and molecular ensemble size. Beyond bistability, pulsed excitation generates staircase-like molecular dynamics, with ascending or descending vibrational populations depending on the optical driving configuration. In particular, the FP cavity controls the buildup of vibrational excitation, while simultaneous driving of both optical modes enables stepwise vibrational depletion. These results establish hybrid molecular optomechanical systems as a tunable platform for history-dependent and pulse-driven molecular dynamics, with potential applications in nanoscale memory, multilevel information processing, and optically controlled molecular switching.

title: Actively stabilized Fabry-Pérot notch filters for correlated photons from cold two-level atoms
summary: We report two actively stabilized Fabry-Pérot cavities operated as reflection-mode notch filters for biphotons generated by spontaneous four-wave mixing in a cold two-level atomic ensemble. In this source, elastic scattering at the excitation frequency increases the single-detector count rates and the accidental-coincidence background, thereby limiting the observed nonclassical correlations. One cavity is placed in each photon-collection mode. An acousto-optic modulator frequency-dithers an auxiliary field, and synchronous demodulation of the transmitted power provides the locking discriminator. Light resonant with the auxiliary field is transmitted, whereas the detuned components are reflected toward the photon detectors. By tuning the auxiliary field to the same frequency as the excitation field, we filter these components and direct a larger portion of the quantum-correlated sidebands to the detection. The cavities have linewidths of approximately 2 MHz and remain locked for longer than a typical correlation acquisition. The measured Cauchy-Schwarz parameter exceeds unity in both configurations, with a higher central value with filtering ($\overline{R} = 4.15 \pm 0.93$) than without ($\overline{R} = 2.33 \pm 0.20$). This architecture provides actively stabilized rejection of a narrow spectral interval, simultaneously, for two fields detected in different directions. Filter performance could be further improved by adjusting the cavity linewidth to better match the spectral width of the central component and by reducing losses in the filters.

title: Unconventional Photon Blockade in Second-Order Nonlinearity Coupled Cavities with Asymmetric Dissipation
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Under review at Phys. Rev. A
summary: We investigate the unconventional photon blockade in a second-order nonlinearity coupled double-cavity system with asymmetric dissipation. By treating the cavity decay rates as independent parameters, we analytically derive two exact families of optimal blockade conditions. While the first family recovers and generalizes the symmetric-dissipation results of previous studies, the second family, arising uniquely from an asymmetric dissipation ratio of $κ_B = 2κ_A$, completely locks the relative phase of the interference pathways. Importantly, we find that this asymmetric dissipation not only renders the optimal blockade condition strictly immune to frequency detuning, but also enhances the blockade depth by an order of magnitude compared to the resonant case. Furthermore, the mean photon number remains almost unaffected, proving that this enhanced robustness is achieved without sacrificing the brightness of the single-photon source. These findings offer a promising route toward robust single-photon generation in passive cavities with second-order nonlinearity.

Our analysis resolves this puzzle and correlates the power law exponents with the trap distributions. Curiously, we show that PL transients could vary as $t^{-2}$ even in the presence of dominant monomolecular recombination while the existing theory associates this unique trend exclusively with dominant bimolecular recombination. These findings identify the limits of applicability of concepts such as differential lifetime and highlight the need for predictive modeling synergistic with insightful data analysis towards performance optimization of perovskite optoelectronic devices.

These results provide quantitative design data for selecting focusing conditions and correcting voxel shape and orientation according to scanning conditions in galvanometer-mirror-based aerial volumetric displays.

A companion metric, the implementation efficiency (IE), compares the SKR with the ideal key rate of its channel, including classical-traffic noise. For fixed loss-limited equipment, NNKR is independent of channel loss, whereas the fraction of the repeaterless bound varies 1.6-fold over 2-25 dB. An analytic model relates the flat loss range of NNKR to the detector noise count rate and dead time. We apply both metrics to ten published coexistence experiments, and NNKR to 42,115 measurements from four systems of two vendors and four high-rate laboratory systems. For one production system, NNKR has a 6.9% coefficient of variation over 17 dB of attenuation and agrees within 0.7 dB with three of four published deployments of that platform. Under coexistence, that platform's NNKR and IE stay within 0.5 dB of their standalone values. In decibels, NNKR is a sum of component penalties, as in an optical link budget, and for one laboratory system the budget from its published parameters and measured secure fraction closes within 0.3 dB.

AI.tldr: 论文针对不同距离、波长、经典业务负载和时钟速率下QKD系统秘密密钥率难以横向比较的问题，提出噪声归一化密钥率（NNKR）和实现效率（IE）两个指标，并用多组已发表实验和大量测量验证其可比性、共存鲁棒性及链路预算可加性。
AI.motivation: 已发表的量子密钥分发（QKD）秘密密钥率（SKR）是在不同距离、波长、经典业务负载和时钟速率下测得的，导致系统之间难以比较，因此需要把SKR分解为可解释、可比较的组件指标。
AI.method: 将SKR表示为发射端时钟速率、信道透射率和每个接收脉冲的秘密密钥量三者乘积；第三个因子即NNKR，需要四个常用报道参数，且在SKR与透射率成正比时主要取决于设备。IE则将SKR与信道的理想密钥率比较，并计入经典业务噪声。作者建立解析模型，将NNKR的平坦损耗范围与探测器噪声计数率和死时间关联；随后把两个指标用于10个已发表共存实验，并将NNKR用于两家厂商四套系统的42,115次测量及四套高速实验室系统。摘要未列出四个常用参数的具体名称。
AI.result: 对一套生产系统，NNKR在17 dB衰减范围内的变异系数为6.9%，并与该平台四组已发表部署中的三组在0.7 dB内一致；在共存条件下，该平台的NNKR和IE与独立运行值相差不超过0.5 dB。固定损耗受限设备下，NNKR与信道损耗无关，而无中继界限的比例在2–25 dB范围内变化1.6倍。以dB表示时，NNKR可写成各分量惩罚之和，类似光链路预算；对一套实验室系统，由其已发表参数和实测安全比例得到的预算闭合误差在0.3 dB内。
AI.conclusion: NNKR和IE为不同距离、波长、经典业务负载和时钟速率下的QKD系统提供了可比指标；NNKR在损耗受限条件下具有设备相关性、共存鲁棒性和dB尺度链路预算可加性，并得到多组已发表实验与大规模测量的支持。摘要未给出四个常用参数的具体名称及全部实验配置。

title: Frequency-bin-encoded quantum secret sharing with fast basis switching
summary: Frequency-bin encoding offers unique opportunities for fiber-native quantum information processing, yet its full potential has been hampered by challenges in rapid state control and protocol scaling. Leveraging high-speed microwave processing, we overcome several extant hurdles and unlock new fundamental capabilities in frequency-based quantum communications. First, we demonstrate three-party quantum secret sharing, representing, to our knowledge, the first multiparty ($N\geq 3$ users) quantum communication protocol implemented entirely with frequency encoding. Second, we demonstrate active, pseudorandom switching of frequency-bin quantum states and measurement bases at 20 MHz symbol rates, enabling real-time protocol operation without relying on hardware-intensive passive basis-selection schemes. Even under fast switching, we preserve high-contrast three-party correlations ($\geq 0.91$) and low quantum bit error rates ($\leq 4.5\%$). Our work extends frequency-bin quantum communication beyond static, two-party protocols, opening a pathway toward scalable, reconfigurable, and real-time spectrally encoded quantum networking.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用高速微波处理实现频率-bin量子通信的快速态控制与协议扩展，首次以频率编码完成三方量子秘密共享，并在20 MHz符号率下实现频率-bin量子态与测量基的主动伪随机切换，保持高对比度三方关联和低量子比特错误率。
AI.motivation: 频率-bin编码在光纤原生量子信息处理方面具有独特潜力，但其快速发展受到快速量子态控制和协议扩展困难的制约；论文旨在克服这些障碍并释放频率编码在量子通信中的新能力。
AI.method: 采用高速微波处理；演示完全基于频率编码的三方量子秘密共享；实现频率-bin量子态和测量基的主动、伪随机切换，符号率为20 MHz，从而不依赖硬件密集型的无源基选择方案。
AI.result: 论文称其三方量子秘密共享是首个完全采用频率编码的多方（N≥3用户）量子通信协议；在快速切换条件下仍保持高对比度三方关联（≥0.91）和低量子比特错误率（≤4.5%）。

title: Free-Space Excitation of Frozen Waves and Topological Edge States in Graphene at a Time Interface
summary: Time-varying two-dimensional materials, such as graphene under ultrafast photoexcitation, offer a promising platform for engineering temporal interfaces for electromagnetic waves. Rapidly promoting valence electrons to the conduction band generates a high-energy, non-thermal hot-electron population that subsequently thermalizes with the pre-existing thermal electron population. We study the excitation of plasmonic modes in graphene by the time interface created by ultra-fast photoexcitation using a graphene electron-transport model that is self-consistently coupled to electromagnetic simulations. We find that in addition to dynamic, propagating plasmonic modes, the time interfaces result in the excitation of static, spatially varying electromagnetic modes in the interaction region sustained by streaming transverse electrons. We also demonstrate a novel technique for coupling free-space light directly to highly localized topological edge states at the magnetic-inversion boundary on graphene, eliminating the need for near-field excitation techniques.

AI.tldr: 该文利用自洽耦合电磁仿真的石墨烯电子输运模型，研究超快光激发形成的时间界面所激发的等离激元模式，并报道时间界面产生的静态、空间变化电磁模式，以及自由空间光直接耦合到石墨烯磁反转边界处拓扑边缘态的方法。
AI.motivation: 时间变化的二维材料（如超快光激发下的石墨烯）为构建电磁波时间界面提供了有前景的平台；作者希望厘清在超快光激发产生高能非热热电子、随后与原有热电子热化的背景下，时间界面如何激发石墨烯中的等离激元模式，并探索无需近场激发即可实现自由空间光与高度局域拓扑边缘态耦合的途径。
AI.method: 采用石墨烯电子输运模型，并将其与电磁仿真自洽耦合，以模拟超快光激发形成的时间界面及其对石墨烯等离激元模式的激发；摘要未提供模型方程、参数、样品或实验验证等细节。
AI.result: 研究发现，时间界面除激发动态传播的等离激元模式外，还会在相互作用区域激发由横向流动电子维持的静态、空间变化电磁模式；同时展示了一种将自由空间光直接耦合到石墨烯磁反转边界处高度局域拓扑边缘态的新技术，从而无需近场激发手段。摘要未提供定量结果或实验数据。

title: Hot-Layer Ignition in High-Gain Inertial Confinement Fusion
summary: Ignition of the shocked deuterium tritium shell is identified during the thermonuclear combustion of very high-gain targets in inertial confinement fusion (ICF). This mechanism is due to the local energy deposition of the fusion alphas created in this shocked shell, independently of hot-spot ignition, and generates sufficient energy to fully recompress the hot spot. A new analytical criterion for the ignition of the hot layer is presented. A simple three zone model, based on the thick layer hot-spot model, reproduces this mechanism, which breaks down into successive stages: ignition of the hot spot, compression of the shocked shell, ignition of the shocked shell, and subsequent recompression of the hot spot. 1D numerical simulations highlight the onset of this hot layer ignition thereby satisfying the analytical ignition criterion. It is shown that this mechanism amplifies the energy released by the combustion of the target by approximately 50 %.

AI.tldr: 在极高增益惯性约束聚变靶中，冲击氘氚壳层点火由该壳层内聚变α粒子的局部能量沉积驱动，可独立于热斑点火并最终重新压缩热斑；新解析判据、三区模型和1D模拟均支持该机制，使靶燃烧释放能量提高约50%。
AI.motivation: 识别并解释极高增益惯性约束聚变靶热核燃烧中的冲击氘氚壳层点火机制，明确其独立于热斑点火，并评估其对热斑再压缩和能量释放的影响。
AI.method: 提出热层点火的新解析判据；基于厚层热斑模型构建简单三区模型，将过程分为热斑点火、冲击壳层压缩、冲击壳层点火和热斑再压缩等阶段；利用1D数值模拟验证该热层点火的起始及解析判据。
AI.result: 1D数值模拟显示热层点火发生并满足解析点火判据；该机制产生足够能量完全重新压缩热斑，并使靶燃烧释放的能量提高约50%。
AI.conclusion: 冲击氘氚壳层点火是极高增益惯性约束聚变靶中独立于热斑点火的重要机制，由聚变α粒子局部能量沉积触发，经多阶段演化增强燃烧，并使能量释放提高约50%。

title: Edge transport mechanisms in small-ELM and type-I ELM regimes at JET using global gyrokinetic simulations
summary: To explore tokamak operating regimes that combine high energy confinement with edge dynamics relevant for ITER, new regimes with small edge-localized modes (ELMs), referred to as baseline small-ELM (BSE), have been obtained at JET with the Be wall and W divertor. In this work, the edge transport mechanisms in a selected BSE discharge are compared with those in a standard H-mode with type-I ELMs using radially global gyrokinetic simulations with the GENE code. The simulations use experimental input profiles and include kinetic electrons and deuterium ions, electromagnetic (EM) effects, and the radially varying equilibrium $E\times B$ flow. At low toroidal mode number $n$, the type-I ELM pedestal is found to be unstable to kinetic-ballooning modes (KBMs), with radial mode structures covering the full pedestal. In the BSE regime, no KBM branch is found, and the same spectral range is dominated by hybrid ITG--TEM modes. The modifications of the linear modes by finite$-β$ effects are discussed in details. In nonlinear simulations of the type-I ELM regime, KBM-driven turbulence produces high transport levels that are resilient to the equilibrium $E\times B$ flow. By contrast, in the BSE regime, EM effects moderately increase transport, which is strongly regulated by the equilibrium $E\times B$ flow. The two regimes also differ in their radial turbulence organization and in the amplitude and persistence of the zonal shearing rate. These results identify the interplay between EM effects and equilibrium $E\times B$ flow as a key element of edge transport regulation.

AI.tldr: 该文在JET的Be壁与W偏滤器条件下研究小ELM基线段（BSE）放电，并与I型ELM标准H模对比，利用GENE全径向回旋动理学模拟揭示边缘输运差异：I型ELM台基由KBM主导且输运对平衡E×B流不敏感，BSE则由ITG–TEM混合模主导且输运受E×B流强烈调控；电磁效应与平衡E×B流的相互作用是边缘输运调节的关键。
AI.motivation: 探索兼具高能量约束和与ITER相关边缘动力学的托卡马克运行区间；在JET获得BSE小ELM新区间后，需要比较其与标准I型ELM H模的边缘输运机制。
AI.method: 选取JET Be壁和W偏滤器条件下的BSE放电与标准I型ELM H模，采用GENE code进行全径向回旋动理学模拟；模拟使用实验剖面，包含动理学电子和氘离子、电磁效应以及径向变化的平衡E×B流。
AI.result: 低环向模数n下，I型ELM台基对动理学气球模（KBM）不稳定，模结构覆盖整个台基；BSE区间未发现KBM分支，同一谱段由ITG–TEM混合模主导。文中详细讨论了有限β对线性模的修正。非线性模拟中，I型ELM区KBM驱动湍流产生高输运且对平衡E×B流具有韧性；BSE区电磁效应适度增强输运，但输运受平衡E×B流强烈调节。两区间在径向湍流组织和带状剪切率的幅度与持续性上也不同。
AI.conclusion: 结果将电磁效应与平衡E×B流的相互作用识别为边缘输运调节的关键要素。

title: Learning effective stochastic predator and prey dynamics across physical and biological systems from limited data
summary: Constructing an effective low-dimensional stochastic model from sparse observations requires separating deterministic drift from state-dependent fluctuations when the governing interaction law is unknown. We formulate an adaptive neural stochastic differential equation with topology constraints (TC-AdaNSDE) for two-variable predator--prey dynamics. To regularize the inverse problem when data are scarce, the model combines flexible drift and correlated diffusion fields with density-adaptive local Kramers--Moyal moment estimates and soft phase-space constraints reflecting boundary saddle behavior near extinction and local stability near coexistence. Using a known nonlinear stochastic system, we first show that short-time trajectory error cannot assess diffusion accuracy on its own and must be paired with distributional measures of one-step transitions and long-time phase-space occupancy. We then apply this framework to macroscopic turbulence and zonal flow energies reduced from Hasegawa--Wakatani plasma simulations and to short ecological time series. In the sparse-data regime, TC-AdaNSDE reproduces both short-horizon evolution and long-time invariant energy distributions where deterministic reductions collapse and unconstrained stochastic fits diverge, while recovering physically interpretable drift and fluctuation fields across both physical and biological systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出带拓扑约束的自适应神经随机微分方程TC-AdaNSDE，用于从稀疏观测中分离确定性漂移与状态相关扩散，并在已知非线性随机系统、Hasegawa–Wakatani等离子体湍流/纬向流能量数据及短生态时间序列上验证其建模与预测能力。
AI.motivation: 在相互作用律未知且观测稀疏时，构建有效低维随机模型需要区分确定性漂移与状态依赖涨落；确定性降维可能失效，无约束随机拟合可能发散。同时，仅用短时轨迹误差不足以评估扩散项精度。
AI.method: 构建面向二变量捕食者—猎物动力学的TC-AdaNSDE，将灵活的漂移场和相关扩散场与密度自适应局部Kramers–Moyal矩估计及软相空间约束结合；约束反映灭绝附近的边界鞍行为和共存附近的局部稳定性。先在已知非线性随机系统上评估，再应用于Hasegawa–Wakatani等离子体模拟降维得到的大尺度湍流与纬向流能量，以及短生态时间序列。
AI.result: 在已知系统中，研究表明短时轨迹误差不能单独评估扩散精度，需结合一步转移的分布度量与长时间相空间占据度量。稀疏数据下，TC-AdaNSDE可复现短时演化与长时间不变能量分布，而确定性降维失效、无约束随机拟合发散；并在物理与生物系统中恢复可物理解释的漂移场和涨落场。
AI.conclusion: TC-AdaNSDE为未知相互作用律和稀疏观测下的低维随机建模提供了带正则化的数据高效框架，并强调应联合使用短时轨迹、分布性一步转移和长时间相空间占据指标进行评估；摘要未给出具体数值性能指标。

title: Measuring and predicting plasma blob influence on downstream transport through paired simulations
summary: We use two-dimensional TOKAM2D simulations of flux-driven turbulence to measure how much a single plasma blob affects particle transport farther out in the scrape-off layer. We evolve the same turbulent state twice, weakening the density and potential variations of one blob in one of the two simulations. The resulting difference in outward particle flux, integrated over time in each poloidal sector of a downstream band, defines the blob's influence vector $α$. Its magnitude falls steeply with distance from the band and generally increases with blob size and density content. Even blobs with similar bulk properties can differ in influence by orders of magnitude. A graph neural network that uses the recent evolution of the fields in and around each blob predicts much of this difference for pairs of otherwise similar blobs. To see how the difference develops, we compare the downstream density and radial velocity in the two simulations. For both strongly and weakly influential blobs in the pairs examined, changes in radial velocity account for most of the local change in outward flux. In the stronger responses, the density and flow contributions tend to reinforce each other in the same sectors at the same times.

AI.tldr: 该文用双胞胎TOKAM2D通量驱动湍流模拟量化单个等离子体团块对刮削层下游粒子输运的影响，并表明团块影响随距离陡降、随尺寸和密度增加而总体增强，且可由图神经网络部分预测。
AI.motivation: 研究单个等离子体团块如何影响更外侧刮削层中的粒子输运，并解释为何体性质相似的团块其影响仍可能相差数量级。
AI.method: 对同一湍流状态进行两次演化，其中一次削弱某个团块的密度和电势涨落；将两次模拟在下游带状区域各极向扇区内随时间积分的外向粒子通量差定义为该团块的影响矢量α；并用基于团块及其周围场近期演化的图神经网络预测相似团块对之间的影响差异，同时比较下游密度与径向速度。
AI.result: α的幅值随距下游带状区域的距离陡峭下降，并总体随团块尺寸和密度含量增加而增大；体性质相似的团块影响可相差数量级。图神经网络能预测相似团块对的大部分影响差异。在所考察的强、弱影响团块对中，径向速度变化贡献了大部分局部外向通量变化；在较强响应中，密度与流动贡献倾向于在相同扇区、相同时间相互增强。
AI.conclusion: 单个团块对下游粒子输运具有可量化且随距离快速衰减的影响，其影响在相似团块间差异显著但可由近期场演化部分预测；局部通量变化主要由径向速度驱动，强响应中密度与流动贡献协同增强。

title: A conservative latent neural ODE for stiff collisional-radiative plasma kinetics
summary: Collisional-radiative (CR) models govern the non equilibrium population kinetics of partially ionized plasmas and are a dominant cost in integrated edge and divertor plasma simulations, where a stiff system of dozens to thousands of coupled rate equations must be solved at every spatial cell and time step. We present a two-stage machine learning (ML) surrogate that replaces the direct CR solve with a compact, continuous-time, deployable dynamical model. Stage~1 is a grey-box autoencoder that compresses a high-dimensional ion population vector into a low-dimensional latent space in which four coordinates, one per charge state of the lithium system studied here, are \emph{fixed} to the physical charge-state distribution and the rest are learned. Stage~2 is a latent neural ODE that learns the continuous-time evolution of the latent variables. We (i) integrate in a density-folded, logarithmic clock on which the latent trajectory is smooth enough for an explicit integrator, (ii) sample time adaptively by latent arc length so the sharp ionization transition is resolved, (iii) add a linear damping toward an estimate of the CR steady state as a design choice, and (iv) enforce mass conservation directly. The surrogate is accurate, with a charge-state error that is unchanged under refinement of its output grid, over full-trajectory rollouts within the trained horizon, and exactly conservative: on $1480$ held-out trajectories at the trained conditions it reproduces the charge-state evolution with a median absolute error of $4.2\times10^{-3}$ on fractions in $[0,1]$, conserves mass to $10^{-7}$, {and evaluates a full sixteen-decade trajectory in ${\sim}76\,μ$s per trajectory in batched inference on a single GPU.} A model retrained with whole $(\nA,\Te)$ grid points withheld is equally accurate at those unseen conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段机器学习代理模型替代碰撞辐射（CR）直接求解：第一阶段用灰盒自编码器将离子布居压缩到低维潜空间，第二阶段用潜空间神经常微分方程学习连续时间演化，并在锂等离子体上实现高精度、质量守恒且可在单 GPU 上批量快速推理。
AI.motivation: CR 模型决定部分电离等离子体的非平衡布居动力学，是集成边缘与偏滤器等离子体模拟的主要计算成本：每个空间网格和时间步都需处理由数十到数千个耦合速率方程组成的刚性系统。作者希望用紧凑、连续时间、可部署的动力学代理模型替代直接 CR 求解。
AI.method: 构建两阶段 ML 代理。阶段 1 为灰盒自编码器，把高维离子布居向量压缩到低维潜空间；在研究的锂体系中，每个电荷态对应一个坐标，共四个坐标固定为物理电荷态分布，其余潜变量学习得到。阶段 2 为潜空间神经 ODE，学习潜变量的连续时间演化。设计包括：在密度折叠的对数时钟上积分以使潜轨迹足够平滑、适合显式积分器；按潜空间弧长自适应采样时间以解析尖锐电离转变；加入朝 CR 稳态估计的线性阻尼；直接施加质量守恒。
AI.result: 代理模型精度较高：电荷态误差在输出网格细化时不变，在训练时域内的完整轨迹滚动中保持准确，并且质量守恒至 10^-7。在训练条件下的 1480 条留出轨迹上，电荷态分数（范围 [0,1]）演化的中位绝对误差为 4.2×10^-3；单 GPU 批量推理时，完整十六个数量级轨迹每条约 76 μs。将整组 (n_A, T_e) 网格点留出后重新训练的模型在这些未见条件下同样准确。
AI.conclusion: 该两阶段潜空间神经 ODE 代理可在所研究的锂 CR 体系中替代直接求解，在训练时域内提供准确的电荷态演化、直接质量守恒和显著加速，并对留出的 (n_A, T_e) 条件具有泛化能力。摘要未提供其他等离子体体系或更长期外推的验证结果。
